name: Tiger
summary: A tiger in a feathered headdress, every stripe painted one at a time.
text:
One of the larger pieces, and one of the slowest to make: the stripes go on one by one, and the headdress is built from coloured wooden feathers.

It sits with its tail curled round to the front. A piece with real presence — it works lit or unlit, and holds its own in daylight as an ornament.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
